title: No piano on the records; May and the club on Rampart
summary: They used no piano on records, but used a woman called May when sight-reading was needed.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Oh, who did you use on piano on the records?
No piano, did we? No piano.

I used to use a girl called May. I don't know if that woman is dead. She's first sight reader, you know. Used to play at this club on Rampo Street. What's the name of that club? On Rampo Street. That young men's business club. Well, always had all those engagements to play there. Lots of time would be in the evening. Well, I'd get May to come in to help us out. Because when you come there, they bring you music right there, and they know Raheisa. See? And she was the kind of woman to help you out, you see?
That's the place in about the 200 block of North Rampo Street?
Yes, between Aberville and Bienville. Oh, yeah. Yeah, that's where the athletic club is. That's the place. That's the place.
